data.title: 毛利兰 · 海浪里的沙滩排球
data.description: 【湘南海岸·盛夏】小兰穿着蓝白运动泳装在沙滩上屈膝接球，身后的遮阳伞和海水被阳光照得发亮；她把球稳稳托起后朝镜头挥手，长发和笑容一起被海风带起。
data.action: 沙滩屈膝接球后朝镜头挥手，长发和笑容一起迎着海风扬起
data.lighting: bright summer sun with clean ocean reflections
data.promptProse: Ran Mouri bends her knees to receive the beach volleyball in her blue-and-white sports swimsuit and light visor. After guiding the ball safely upward, she waves toward the viewer with wind lifting her long hair. The horizontal medium view keeps beach umbrellas and bright sea behind her grounded stance. Clean summer sunlight defines the ball and ankle bands, with a compact sand shadow beneath her feet and reflected blue along the shaded arm.
